div.div:
Facts are shared: the guided pages and the chat both read and write VariableAnswer,
so an answer given in one shows up in the other. That is the path that works.
Content is not shared yet. The pages render content/, the chat reads corpus/ through
the sync_corpus rows, and editing one tree does not update the other (#179).
That is the red path.
